bodyMarkdown:
## Highlights

- Improved the text system to support future localization
- Prepared the app for character-based voice and UI copy in later updates
- Made legal and update-related text clearer

## Improvements

- Continued polish across Settings, onboarding, and content screens

## Why this matters

Text & Localization Foundation (v3.3.0) is one of those tidy-up releases that does not need a parade, but it still helps the site feel less fussy. Small fixes matter here because CogniFocus is supposed to get out of your way fast. Tap in, start the thing, dodge the scroll spiral, continue your tiny heroic quest. That is the whole deal.

- Improved the text system to support future localization gets a little more room to breathe.
- Prepared the app for character-based voice and UI copy in later updates gets a little more room to breathe.
- Made legal and update-related text clearer gets a little more room to breathe.
- Continued polish across Settings, onboarding, and content screens gets a little more room to breathe.

So yes, this is a smaller note. The point is still real: fewer weird little moments, clearer feedback, and less friction between you and the session you meant to start. The Goblin may still be dramatic about it, obviously, but the app should feel calmer where it counts.
